ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65% high-intensity white/light-grey pixels concentrated in central lobe regions versus 35% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels along the periphery and midline.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized contiguous high-intensity white regions on both lobes; dense, low-intensity black mottling concentrated along the trailing edges and distal tips; a distinct vertical low-intensity band bisecting the lobes at the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 125 degrees and a wide, low-depth bounding box.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration with high-frequency peaks and valleys; notable large-amplitude notch on the distal upper boundary of the left lobe; ragged, non-linear edge on the right tip due to bio-fouling.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a convex curve leading to an acute distal tip; right lobe exhibits a more linear sweep ending in a blunt, irregular distal termination.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast cluster of circular brown/white pixel groups (barnacle colonization) at the distal tip of the right lobe; smaller white circular clusters on the leading edge of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint diagonal low-intensity linear disruption visible on the lower interior of the right lobe; secondary faint vertical streaks on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant structural irregularity and parasitic encrustation (barnacles) on the right distal tip, creating an asymmetrical edge profile compared to the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense salt-and-pepper transition zone between black and white pigmentation on the interior trailing edge of the left lobe.
